definitions.coverage: top1/top5 ask whether any authored relevant section was found; recall@5 is relevant authored sections found divided by relevant section count; MRR@5 uses first relevant rank
definitions.noHit: queries with an empty authored relevantSections list are reported separately as true-negative / false-positive counts
definitions.factQuality: old7 top-1 hit's executable bounded wiki_read text is checked for the frozen answer literal; offset-before-answer is reported separately
